0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Unruly patrons have Yamehwi at wit's end.

25.original: Use the well water to sober up unruly patrons.

48.original: <sigh> Now what am I supposed to do?

49.original: Say, you strike a rather imposing figure. Can I ask a favor of you?

50.original: A few of our regulars have gotten a little too deep in their cups, and all their commotion is starting to turn away customers. They refuse to leave, and there's not much more I can do without stirring up trouble.

51.original: Someone as intimidating as you, on the other hand, could get away with a great deal. In fact, I'd wager you could douse them with water and they'd sooner go home than lift a finger against you. There's a well not far from here if you'd be willing to try and sober them up.

52.original: Between you and me, they could all stand to take a bath anyway. A quick drenching with water from the well should bring them to their senses.

53.original: Hey, do you... Do you know <hic> what time it is? I suppose it doesn't matter.

55.original: Dammit, now I need to go and get changed.

56.original: No, no, no! I don't wanna hear it! I don't pay you to talk─now go and get my drink!

57.original: Bugger me with a rroneek's horn, that's cold! What're you trying to do, drown me!?

58.original: Bah, I'm too tired for this. I'm going home...

59.original: Come on, don't be shy! Just follow the rhythm and let your hips do the rest.

60.original: Hey, what are you─ And I was just getting warmed up.

61.original: Oh gods, what time is it? The boss'll kill me if I'm late again!

62.original: I saw the whole thing. Thank you so much.

63.original: They can get carried away sometimes after a few drinks, but they're good folk. Miners and railroad workers, the lot of them, as are most of the people who pass through here.

64.original: After a long, grueling day, they'll often stop by and unwind for a good spell.

65.original: It's only when they get a little <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> comfortable that it starts to become a problem.

66.original: A problem for another day, thanks to you. I know it's not much, but I'd like you to have this. After all your help, it's the least I can offer.
